title: ICC-ES ESR-1375: Atlas EnergyShield insulation boards (also used as a WRB alternative)
jurisdiction: United States (ICC-ES evaluation report under IBC/IRC); NON-ALBERTA COMPARATIVE ONLY: cannot establish Alberta performance, acceptance or equivalence; no Canadian or Alberta approval is claimed or implied
code_edition: 2021, 2018, 2015 and 2012 IBC, IRC and IECC (report §1.1, p1)
document_date: Reissued March 2026; subject to renewal March 2028 (p1)

facts.text: Report holder ATLAS ROOFING CORPORATION; subject is EnergyShield XR, CGF, PanelCast, CGF Pro and Pro insulation boards.
Use in exterior walls of Types I through IV construction under the IBC is outside the scope of the report.
Boards on the exterior face must be covered with an approved exterior wall cladding; where not used as the alternative WRB, the wall needs a WRB complying with the code.
Structural resistance to transverse, racking-shear or vertical loads is outside the scope; boards may not be a nailing base for siding.
Boards are manufactured at Atlas plants including Delta, British Columbia, Canada and Etobicoke, Ontario, Canada, under ICC-ES inspections (location statement only).
Evidence listed: AC12 (June 2015, editorially revised December 2020); AC71 (February 2003, revised March 2021) for foam sheathing used as a WRB; NFPA 286; ASTM E2357; ASTM E2178; ASTM C272.

limitations: Non-Alberta comparative attachment; the report does not reference NBC(AE) 2023 and is not evidence of Alberta or Canadian acceptance.
